text:
zoe_cs: Quick sync  Nebulon onboarding tomorrow 09:00PT. They want Dedicated pool live with 200 steady RPS headroom, autoscale min 4 -> max 20, and a short burn-in. Renewal flagged for Q3 so zero surprises please. Can ops run the commissioning?

amar_ops: I got this. Plan: quick smoke 3m @40rps, ramp 20m to 200rps, 5m spike to 300rps, then 15m soak at 200rps. Will collect traces and token-level cost. Need quota id + KMS role.

fred_sre: Reserving 1 extra node and enabling safe-mode autoscale (target_util 55%). I'll pin rollout to the test namespace. If we see sustained 5xx >0.8% for 90s -> abort.

anya_se: Nebulon noted heavy long-contexts. Recommend prefix cache TTL 12m, kv_cache window 4k entries, and priming instructions for SEs. I'll publish a short checklist.

vik_ml: We'll serve quantized 1.2 snapshot. I'll precompile seq256/512 kernels and post perf CSV.

amar_ops: load command (vegeta):
```bash
echo "GET https://dedicated.internal/neb/proxy" | vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=20m | vegeta report
```
Rotation: 60% short prompts, 30% medium, 10% long.

zoe_cs: Billing check: quota 76399  map to nebula-onboard-us, billing code NB-ENT-ONB? @billingbot

billingbot: mapping: 76399 -> nebula-onboard-us -> NB-ENT-ONB-2024 :white_check_mark:

fred_sre: Autoscale patch PR #4302. Lower target_util for test, min_replicas 4, max 20. I will watch autoscaler and revert if churning.

anya_se: SE note: provide Nebulon an itemized priming guide and the chunked payload example. They asked for a pre-test runbook snippet.

amar_ops: Rollback criteria added: p99 latency > 1.8s for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate jump > 0.8% for 90s OR unexpected quota-deny. Also billing guard: abort if projected test spend > +15% of estimate.

zoe_cs: I'll run customer-facing postmortem capture form after the test to log feedback, friction points, and renewal risk items. Post-test sync 11:10PT. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nebula-warmup-1766791111

billingbot: Run scheduled and permissions OK.

zoe_cs: Thanks all 64f closing thread unless blockers.
